findings.issue: The type page was written four times in a row because each write contained hallucinated imports and undefined helpers ('TypeBadgePlace…', 'uniqueRelatedTypes'); the same disease hit moves and abilities pages (turns 42, 44-45).
findings.suggestion: Compose the complete file in one pass and grep it for undefined identifiers before writing; slow down when the model notices 'autopilot' output.

findings.issue: `pkill -f 'next-server'` matched the invoking bash command line and killed the shell (exit 143) — repeated twice in identical form before the ps/awk workaround.
findings.suggestion: Use `ps -eo pid,comm | awk '$2 ~ /^next-server/' | xargs -r kill` (which it eventually adopted) or kill by recorded PID the first time.

findings.issue: Read pi's extensions.md — irrelevant to a Next.js build task; and zero web searches/fetches/skill reads all session, so Next 16.4.3 behaviors (fetch caching, dynamic rendering, history patching) were relied on from memory.
findings.suggestion: Spend one turn checking the Next 16 docs/route segment config reference before betting the build strategy on remembered semantics.

findings.issue: Two malformed write invocations (wrong absolute path; `file` instead of `path`), plus a stray '/workspace/pkg/next-app/...' content from a different project.
findings.suggestion: Verify path and argument names before each write call.

findings.issue: Three failed attempts at image analysis (python PIL absent, pip absent, node one-liner typo `p is not defined`) before settling on npm pngjs.
findings.suggestion: Probe the environment once (`which pip; python3 -c 'import PIL'`) instead of trying tools optimistically.

findings.issue: `npm test -- --version | head -5` actually launched the full harness install/build (SIGPIPE'd after 5 lines), leaving background processes to check for.
findings.suggestion: Check the runner script's arg handling (it was already read at turn 2) before assuming --version is a no-op.

findings.issue: Several write calls knowingly included junk ('leftover weirdness': unused nextUrl/itemSlot helpers, duplicate hrefFor, onInput+onChange double-binding), deferred to a later cleanup pass (turn 116).
findings.suggestion: Write clean code the first time; the deferred cleanup worked here but risks shipping dead code.

summary: A model process overall: exhaustive up-front reconnaissance (spec, tests, overlay fixture, data shapes, all reference screenshots), a correct architecture decided before coding (force-dynamic + no-store to survive the live-data overlay), first full test pass right after the initial build, and a rare-quality visual verification pass with a custom pixel-diff harness at both required widths, ending in a clean 54/54 suite run after the last code edit. Deductions are for avoidable sloppiness: hallucinated-import file rewrites, a twice-repeated self-killing pkill, malformed write calls, and zero doc/web verification of Next 16 semantics.
